title: Relative-cone presheaf realization of the Ind Cartesian fibration
statement:
Use small infinity categories and coherent functors from [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], the filtered Ind construction from [def-coef-presentable-infinity-category] and [lem-coef-ind-kappa-presentability], the coherent right-adjoint Ind diagram from [lem-coef-ind-right-adjoint-coherent], and Cartesian and cocartesian fibrations from [def-coef-infinity-fibrations]. For a small simplicial set $D$, put $\mathcal P(D)=\operatorname{Fun}(D^{\mathrm{op}},\mathcal S)$, where $\mathcal S$ is the infinity category of small spaces. Let $A$ be a small infinity category, write $y:A\to\mathcal P(A)$ for the Yoneda functor $a\mapsto\operatorname{Map}_A(-,a)$, let $F_0:A\to\operatorname{Cat}^{\mathrm{rex}(\lambda)}_\infty$ be a coherent functor for an infinite regular cardinal $\lambda$ in the smaller universe, and let $p:E\to A$ be its associated cocartesian fibration. Define the relative left cone
$$E_A^{\triangleleft}:=A\amalg_{E\times\{0\}}(E\times\Delta^1),$$
where $E\times\{0\}\to A$ is $p$ and $E\times\{0\}\hookrightarrow E\times\Delta^1$ is the inclusion at $0$; write $j:A\hookrightarrow E_A^{\triangleleft}$ for the other inclusion, and write $-\infty_a$ for the image in $E_A^{\triangleleft}$ of $a\in A$. Let $H:A^{\mathrm{op}}\to\operatorname{Cat}_\infty$ be the coherent functor supplied by [lem-coef-ind-right-adjoint-coherent]: $H(a)=\operatorname{Ind}_\lambda(F_0(a))$, and for $f:a\to a'$ the morphism $H(f^{\mathrm{op}}):H(a')\to H(a)$ is the right adjoint of the $\lambda$-filtered-colimit-preserving extension of $F_0(f)$. Let $\mathcal P^{\mathrm{cocart}}_\lambda(E_A^{\triangleleft})$ be the full subcategory of $\mathcal P(E_A^{\triangleleft})$ spanned by presheaves $\phi:(E_A^{\triangleleft})^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathcal S$ satisfying both conditions below. (i) For every cocartesian edge $\bar\alpha:e\to\alpha_!e$ of $p$ over $\alpha:a\to b$ in $A$, the square
$$\begin{CD}
\phi(\alpha_!e) @>>> \phi(e)\\
@VVV @VVV\\
\phi(-\infty_b) @>>> \phi(-\infty_a)
\end{CD}$$
induced by $\bar\alpha$ and the cone arrows is a pullback square of spaces. (ii) For every $\lambda$-small colimit diagram $\bar q:K^{\triangleright}\to E_a$ in a fiber, with colimit vertex $q(\infty)$, the composite
$$(K^{\triangleleft\triangleright})^{\mathrm{op}}\to(E_a^{\triangleleft})^{\mathrm{op}}\to(E_A^{\triangleleft})^{\mathrm{op}}\xrightarrow{\phi}\mathcal S,$$
where the initial cone point maps to $-\infty_a$, the $K$-part maps by $q$, and the terminal cone point maps to $q(\infty)$, is a limit diagram. Then restriction along $j$ is a Cartesian fibration
$$j^*:\mathcal P^{\mathrm{cocart}}_\lambda(E_A^{\triangleleft})\to\mathcal P(A),$$
whose classifying functor is the unique limit-preserving extension $\widehat H:\mathcal P(A)^{\mathrm{op}}\to\operatorname{Cat}_\infty$ of the explicitly defined $H$ along $y^{\mathrm{op}}$. The statement includes the coherent higher simplices and is relative to the fixed universe; $E$ and the presheaf categories may lie in a containing universe.
